actions.add-contact-to-list.description: Add a contact or multiple contacts to an existing contact list.
actions.add-contact-to-list.props.contac: JSON array of contacts to add to the list. Each contact must have phone_number and can include name and template_variables.
actions.add-contact-to-list.props.list_i: Select the contact list to add contacts to.
actions.create-campaign.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.
actions.create-campaign.props.agent_id.d: Select the AI agent to use for the campaign.
actions.create-campaign.props.delay_betw: Time to wait between calls in seconds.
actions.create-campaign.props.list_id.de: Select the contact list for the campaign.
actions.create-campaign.props.rotate_num: Number of contacts to call before rotating to the next phone number.
actions.create-campaign.props.scheduled_: When to start the campaign (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) ISO 8601.
actions.create-campaign.props.sender_pho: Select phone numbers to use for making calls.
actions.create-campaign.props.timezone.d: Timezone for the scheduled time (e.g., America/New_York).
actions.create-contact-list.props.contac: JSON array of contacts. Each contact must have phone_number and can include name, template_variables.
actions.create-contact-list.props.descri: A description of the contact list (optional).
actions.create-contact-list.props.name.d: The name of the contact list.
actions.delete-campaign.description: Delete a campaign with optional contact list deletion.
actions.delete-campaign.props.campaign_i: The ID of the campaign to delete.
actions.delete-campaign.props.delete_con: Also delete the associated contact list (optional).
actions.edit-contact-list.description: Update/replace all contacts in an existing contact list.
actions.edit-contact-list.props.contacts: JSON array of contacts to replace the entire list
Select the contact list to edit.
actions.get-call-details.description: Retrieve details of a specific call by call SID.
The unique identifier of the call.
actions.get-contacts-from-list.descripti: Retrieve all contacts from a specific contact list.
actions.get-contacts-from-list.props.lis: Select the contact list to retrieve contacts from.
actions.make-call.description: Initiate an outbound call using Kallabot AI agent.
actions.make-call.props.agent_id.descrip: Select the AI agent to use for the call.
actions.make-call.props.recipient_phone_: The phone number to call in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890).
actions.make-call.props.sender_phone_num: The phone number to make the call from.
actions.make-call.props.template_variabl: Variables to be used in the agent template (optional).
actions.make-call.props.webhook_url.desc: URL to receive call status updates (optional).
auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Kallbot API Key:

1. Go to [Kallabot](https://kallabot.com/) and log in to your account.
2. Click on your profile picture in the top right corner.
3. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu.
4. Navigate to the **API & Integrations** tab.
5. Copy the generated API key and paste it here.
description: AI-powered voice agents and conversational interfaces.
triggers.catch_webhook.description: Receives webhook data when call events occur from Kallabot AI agents.
triggers.catch_webhook.props.instruction:
**Setup Instructions:**
1. Copy the webhook URL below.
2. In your Kallabot AI agent configuration, go to Actions/Webhooks settings  .
3. Enable webhooks and paste the webhook URL.
4. Your agent will now send call data to this webhook when a call ends.
triggers.catch_webhook.props.testInstruc:
**Test URL:**

If you want to generate sample data without triggering the flow, append `/test` to your webhook URL.
